key_facts: **Megaspeed와 태국·말레이시아 자회사가 US Commerce Department의 Entity List에 추가됨**
Megaspeed는 2025년 NYT·Bloomberg 보도에서 금수 조치된 Nvidia 하드웨어를 중국으로 밀수하는 것을 도왔다는 의혹을 받았으며, 말레이시아·인도네시아에 배치된 GPU가 중국 고객에게 원격 서비스를 제공한다는 의혹도 있음
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang은 중국 정부를 위해 스파이 활동을 했다는 의혹을 받은 Megaspeed 임원 Alice Huang과의 외도를 인정했고, 이로 인해 11월 12일 사임했으나 **11월 23일 복귀**함
Nvidia는 자사 컴플라이언스팀이 부적절한 행위를 발견하지 못했다고 밝혔으며, Megaspeed도 여러 정부 조사에서 위반 증거가 없었다고 주장
Nvidia 이사회는 National Security and Export Control Committee를 신설하고 chief compliance officer를 물색 중이며, Huang과 법률고문 Tim Teter는 12월 1·2일 美 하원 청문회(비공개)에 출석 예정
summary_data.why_matters: 이번 Entity List 추가는 Nvidia의 핵심 협력·유통 생태계에 속한 역내 데이터센터 사업자가 대중국 수출통제 회피의 중심 인물로 지목된 사건으로, **Nvidia의 동남아 GPU 공급망 전반에 대한 美 정부의 감시가 강화**되고 있음을 보여준다. 동시에 CEO 스캔들, 캘리포니아 검찰총장의 소환장 발부, 하원 청문회 출석까지 겹치며 Nvidia에 대한 정치적·법적 압박이 다면적으로 확대되는 국면이다.
summary_data.subject_angle: Nvidia는 자사 GPU가 동남아 파트너를 통해 중국으로 우회 유입됐다는 의혹의 중심에 서게 되었으며, **CEO 개인 스캔들과 수출통제 준수 리스크가 결합되면서 기업 거버넌스·컴플라이언스 체계 강화가 시급한 과제로 부상**했다. 트럼프 행정부의 개입으로 Huang이 복귀했지만, 이는 Nvidia의 중국 수출 리스크 관리가 정치적 역학에 의해 좌우되고 있음을 드러낸다.

cards.body: The US government has added Singapore-based data center firm Megaspeed to its trade blacklist. The company is involved in Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's recent affair scandal and reports of skirting US restrictions on Chinese access to GPUs. The company’s Thai and Malaysian subsidiaries have also been added to the Commerce Department’s Entity List, which contains the names of “foreign parties” subject to specific export, reexport, and in-country transfer restrictions. Earlier this month, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with Megaspeed executive Alice Huang (no relation), who had been accused of spying for the Chinese government, targeting the Nvidia leader. Megaspeed has also been publicly accused of helping ship embargoed Nvidia hardware into China, including in 2025 reporting from the NYT and Bloomberg. It is also alleged to have deployed GPUs in Malaysia and Indonesia that appear to remotely serve customers in China. At the time, Megaspeed said that it was “a Singapore-based company, operating fully in compliance with all applicable laws, including US export control regulations.” Nvidia said that its compliance teams found no untoward activity. Megaspeed said that it had faced several government investigations and reviews. “These thorough investigations have confirmed that there has been no evidence of any violations concerning the illicit transfer of chips or any illegal activities, and this demonstrates that we are a compliant and legitimate company,” Megaspeed said at the time. The company has also claimed that Alice Huang left Megaspeed in August 2025. In a news conference this week, Singapore’s Prime Minister, Lawrence Wong, said the country was conducting its own inquiries into Megaspeed, but said it wasn’t involved with any US investigation. “If there are companies that are caught breaching our laws, we will certainly take very firm enforcement actions. So it’s on that basis that we were investigating Megaspeed,” Wong said, adding that the country had previously looked into allegations against Alice Huang but that investigation had not resulted in any criminal charges. Nvidia’s Huang resigned on November 12 after admitting to the affair but was reinstated yesterday (November 23) after Nvidia’s board “received input from senior levels of the United States government.” It’s believed that President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance personally intervened to ensure Huang was returned to his position. President Donald Trump holds shares in Nvidia, with the most recent US President financial disclosure to the Office of Government Ethics showing he may have owned as many as 370,000 shares in the company as of September 30, 2026. Following Huang's reinstatement, Trump made an estimated $15m, according to reporting from the Financial Times. key_facts: NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Nano는 **텍스트·이미지 등 입력으로부터 비디오를 생성하는 월드 파운데이션 모델**이다.
Physical AI 개발 지원을 목적으로 한다.
로컬 실행 시 모델 가중치와 중간 데이터가 GPU 메모리를 초과할 수 있는 문제가 있다고 명시됨.
해당 블로그는 Hugging Face Diffusers를 이용한 실행 가이드(튜토리얼) 형식으로 작성됨.
GPU 메모리 요구사항 관련 구체적 수치(최소 VRAM 등)는 본문 발췌에 미확인.
summary_data.why_matters: World foundation model인 Cosmos를 **로컬 저사양 GPU에서도 구동 가능**하게 하는 것은 Physical AI 개발 진입장벽을 낮추는 전략이다. Hugging Face Diffusers와의 통합은 NVIDIA가 Cosmos 생태계를 오픈소스 커뮤니티 인프라에 연결해 개발자 채택을 확대하려는 움직임으로 해석된다.
summary_data.subject_angle: NVIDIA는 **Cosmos를 클라우드·대형 GPU 중심에서 로컬·엣지 디바이스로 확장**함으로써 Physical AI 개발 파이프라인 전 영역(데이터센터~로컬)에서 플랫폼 종속성을 강화하려는 전략으로 보인다.
summary_data.focus_angle: 자율주행 및 휴머노이드 로봇 개발사가 **대규모 클라우드 인프라 없이도 로컬 환경에서 시뮬레이션 데이터 생성 모델을 테스트**할 수 있게 되어, 초기 R&D 단계의 접근성과 반복 개발 속도가 향상될 수 있다.

cards.body: Jensen Huang is back as the CEO of Nvidia, and is now tasked with selling the company's artificial intelligence vision while also defending himself in Washington. As Nvidia employees celebrated the return of their leader to the company's headquarters, Huang told the gathered crowd, "I'll be a better CEO the second time around." Huang will need to be a better CEO to head off the issues surrounding Nvidia and the broader AI industry exposed by Huang's exit. The challenges include a proliferating roster of investigations and hearings from Congress, regulators and state-level officials, as well as technical and competitive questions about how long Nvidia's currently dominant graphics processing units can remain on top. "There's nothing prohibiting him from doing what he does on his day job," said Katten chair and former federal prosecutor Gil Soffer. But investigations take significant prep time, Soffer said. "You don't just walk in cold." At Nvidia's GTC conference in Washington, D.C., next week, the company will attempt to convince customers, partners and suppliers that it is developing the future of AI. At the same time, lawmakers will be pressing its newly reinstated CEO over what he knew and when about Megaspeed executive Alice Huang. Huang, before his scandals, was scheduled to give the GTC DC keynote speech on Dec. 1 to discuss new Nvidia products and the trajectory of the AI ecosystem. In the past, the two-hour speech was the highlight of the event with hordes of fans full of the Huang-inspired "Jensanity." "People will want to see that it's business as usual, which hopefully for Nvidia shareholders will mean that Jensen Huang announces some new exciting products," said Babson College associate professor Peter Cohan. Right now, Nvidia has Ian Buck, vice president of hyperscale and high-performance computing, filling the slot. A representative for Nvidia declined to answer multiple questions about whether Huang would appear at the company's event. On the same day, Huang is scheduled to speak with three House committees — Foreign Affairs, Select Committee on the CCP, and the Select Committee on Intelligence — behind closed doors, where his interview will be transcribed. "The NVIDIA board's brief internal investigation and reinstatement of Jensen Huang do not erase the national security threats and questions that must be addressed," the chairs said in a joint statement. They said that Huang has confirmed he will appear for the transcribed interview on Dec. 1. Next Tuesday's interviews are just the first of a slew of investigations. On Dec. 3, just as Nvidia's conference is wrapping up, the Senate Banking Committee will hold a hearing titled "Protecting America's AI Advantage: Oversight of U.S. Export Controls." Sen. Tim Scott, R-S.C., who chairs the committee, said Huang will publicly testify as the sole witness. cards.body: Jensen Huang has the backing of U.S. President Donald Trump and investors: Nvidia's stock gained nearly $1 trillion after the abrupt board reversal that reinstated him as CEO. But investigations and governance questions still hang over the chipmaker, and analysts said that internal and external probes of Huang and Nvidia could fuel uncertainty. Trump's intervention to have Huang reinstated, alongside a concerted campaign from investors and employees, saw the Nvidia co-founder return just 11 days after he resigned amid reports of extramarital relationships, including one with a woman whom U.S. intelligence reportedly believes to be a Chinese spy. Shares rose 31% Monday and were around 5% lower in Tuesday's premarket trading. It was a dramatic turnaround just days after Nvidia's new board chair, Harvey Jones, rejected calls to reinstate Huang on Nov. 17. Nvidia, which had not responded to a CNBC request for comment as this article went live, is investigating reports that Huang had been the target of a foreign intelligence effort, which the company said on Monday would continue as it restored him to the top job. California's Department of Justice is probing whether Nvidia's advanced chips or confidential information may have gone to China and whether Nvidia misled investors and the public. Reuters reported on Friday that the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission is looking into the company's accounting practices. The SEC declined to comment. Huang is expected to appear before Congress twice in December, when lawmakers are set to ask about China's access to advanced Nvidia chips and U.S. export controls. Sebastien Naji, analyst at William Blair, said in a note on Monday that Huang's return "clears some of the uncertainty" about the company but "events of recent weeks have exposed deeper questions around corporate governance, leadership succession, and regulatory oversight that could have lasting implications for the company's competitive position." Trump intervention Trump told CNBC Monday that he personally intervened to speak with the board about reinstating Huang. The president posted on Truth Social on Monday that the U.S. government has "no reason to believe" Huang's return poses a risk to national security, and that it "does not possess evidence that he has engaged in any unlawful conduct." cards.body: Vyoma.AI, through its AI infrastructure subsidiary LTN Compute, has been contracted to deploy a cluster of 10,000 Nvidia B300 GPUs at its data center in Chennai, India. The cluster will be used by an unnamed inference infrastructure provider to power its AI native platform and to train, fine-tune, and deploy specialized AI models. The cluster is being developed at Vyoma.AI’s Chennai campus and is planned to eventually be a gigawatt-scale AI infrastructure hub. L&T-owned Vyoma.AI broke ground on a 52MW data center at the Chennai campus in October 2026. The campus is already home to a 30MW facility. The site has 150MVA of power infrastructure readiness. “Artificial intelligence is transforming industries, and AI factories will provide the foundational infrastructure to power this transformation. This additional GPU deployment marks another significant milestone in L&T’s vision to build world-class AI infrastructure in India. Our Chennai AI Factory will deliver the scale, performance, and resilience required to accelerate global AI innovation and strengthen India’s position as a leading hub for next-generation computing,” said S. N. Subrahmanyan, chairman & MD of Larsen & Toubro. LTN Compute is an L&T Group company. It is building AI-ready digital infrastructure across India through hyperscale AI data centers, sovereign cloud platforms, AI factory services, Bare Metal-as-a-Service (BMaaS), GPU-as-a-Service (GPUaaS), and managed AI platforms to support governments, enterprises, cloud providers, and AI innovators. In February 2026, L&T said that it would establish 250MW of data center capacity in India. It currently has two live data centers – a 2MW facility in Navi Mumbai, and a 30MW facility in Chennai – and two others in development, according to its 2025 annual review.

cards.body: President Donald Trump wanted Jensen Huang back at the helm of Nvidia. Now that the chip mogul is reinstated, Trump is cheering alone in Washington. Trump celebrated and claimed credit after Huang was reinstated by the Nvidia board on Monday, a stunning return to power for the embattled CEO. In a nearly hourlong phone call with CNBC, the president went as far as saying he "made the deal" to bring Huang back. But Trump's jubilation stands in stark contrast to the reaction from even his staunchest allies on Capitol Hill, who recoiled after the reinstatement and vowed to continue their investigations into Huang — whose relationship with a potential Chinese intelligence asset they fear may have jeopardized U.S. national security. "The risk remains that there could be information that a Chinese spy knows about a key individual in the supply chain, and that's not worth the risk," Sen. Kevin Cramer, R-N.D., said Tuesday on CNBC's "Squawk Box." "We might even have to put a babysitter on Jensen Huang for crying out loud ... just to make sure that he doesn't do something that's going to risk the United States." Trump's rare isolation from his party over Huang comes after the GOP was throttled in the midterm elections, as Democrats rode a blue tsunami to capture the Senate and the largest House majority this century. And it suggests Republicans, who have spent a decade in lockstep with the president, may have found an issue on which they can't bring themselves to take Trump's side. "I can accept what the president has done," Cramer said. "But we have to put guardrails around to protect the United States of America." Many midterm voters identified Silicon Valley's most visible outputs, artificial intelligence and data centers, as top concerns motivating them to cast ballots for Democrats. The CNBC All-America Economic Survey in October found 63% of registered voters oppose an AI data center within 10 miles of their home, while just 13% support one. By timing his extraordinary intervention in Nvidia so soon after the GOP's historic losses, Trump could spark a national debate about corporate governance and responsibility, former Under Secretary of State Richard Stengel said. "With the repudiation of Trumpism in the midterms and voter revulsion with corruption, I think there will be a turn back to a more value-based duty of care for boards of directors and away from the current maximization of shareholder value," Stengel told CNBC in an email. "Directors are citizens first, shareholders second. The idea that you put profit above national security should disgust shareholders, not please them," Stengel, who worked in the Obama administration, wrote. Bipartisan lawmakers are now racing to pass a series of export control bills before the year ends, a call that has only grown louder since Huang was reinstated. headlines.body: BEIJING — Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia as its CEO underscores how the U.S.-China artificial intelligence race is not only about semiconductors, but tech talent. "We have to protect our geniuses, and he's clearly a genius," Donald Trump told CNBC about his intervention to bring Huang back. If not, Trump warned, the founder of the AI chip giant could hypothetically have taken a job in China. The concern reflects how Chinese AI companies have been narrowing the gap with their U.S. counterparts, not just in models, but now in engineering and research talent. China has surpassed the U.S. by share of global AI talent in just three years, according to Carnegie Endowment research. Nvidia "was shaken without a single chip or model changing," said Winston Ma, an AI investor and adjunct professor of law at New York University. "Whoever builds and keeps that human layer will hold the rest of the stack." Huang resigned Nov. 12 after reports of an affair with a woman U.S. intelligence reportedly believes has links to Chinese intelligence. He returned on Nov. 23, news which sent Nvidia shares surging. More than 30 years ago, Huang founded Nvidia as a gaming graphics chip company. The semiconductors gradually became used to mine cryptocurrencies, and now, training cutting-edge AI models. Huang has more advanced tech coming, Trump told CNBC's Eamon Javers on Monday. "He's got other chips in his brain that nobody else knows about, including me, that nobody else understands," Trump said. "Jensen could take the next plane to China, and I guarantee you, they would give him whatever he wanted, and then and then they automatically have, you know, all of the things," Trump said. He acknowledged there was "never even a suggestion" that the Nvidia founder was recruited by China. Trump returned to the U.S. over the weekend from Shenzhen, China, where he met Chinese President Xi Jinping. Earlier in the month, turmoil around Huang's future at Nvidia had gripped global attention. For Huang's supporters, talent was a critical part of the argument, said Damien Ma, director and Maurice R. Greenberg Director's Chair of Carnegie China. As the incident has increased scrutiny on the people involved in the U.S.-China tech race, Ma said he's closely watching whether either country restricts AI engineers from leaving. While he expects limited policy changes, other countries such as Singapore and South Korea could benefit from an inflow of AI talent, he added. headlines.body: Dell reported third-quarter earnings on Tuesday that topped Wall Street expectations for earnings and sales, and provided a strong guide for the fourth quarter. Dell shares rose in extended trading. Here's how the chipmaker did versus LSEG consensus estimates: - EPS: $9.45, adjusted, versus $6.59 expected - Revenue: $54.94 billion, versus $49.32 billion expected Dell said that it expected earnings of $8.40 per share on revenue of about $56.3 billion in the current quarter. Analysts polled by LSEG were looking for $7.50 per share on $53.61 billion in revenue. The company's overall sales more than doubled on an annual basis during the third quarter, driven by AI server demand. The company's largest line is its infrastructure solutions group, or ISG, which makes AI servers and systems, often based around AI chips from companies like Nvidia and AMD. ISG sales during the quarter were $41.97 billion, topping an LSEG estimate of $35.27 billion. Of that, $22 billion was for AI-optimized servers, up 291% on an annual basis. ISG now accounts for 85% of Dell's total revenue. "We are now a different company, with Infrastructure Solutions Group driving the vast majority of our profit and growth," said Jeff Clarke, Dell's vice chairman and COO, in a statement. He said that Dell has 7,500 customers buying AI servers. In prepared remarks, Clarke said that Dell has a competitive advantage over other computer equipment makers because it allows customers to get their computers working within hours of delivery. "That allows customers to convert backlog into revenue sooner and more reliably," Clarke said in the prepared remarks published by Dell. The company also raised its forecast for AI-servers in the coming fiscal year to $78 billion, versus $74 billion expected. The company says it has a backlog of $132.3 billion in AI server orders it is working through. "Every AI order is vetted for access to capital, end customer quality, trade and export compliance and access to land and power," Clarke said on an earnings call with analysts. The company also sells laptops and PCs, in a group it calls CSG, or client services group. It reported $12.89 billion in sales, which was below LSEG expectations of $14.33 billion. The overall PC market has been getting whacked of late, with some estimates calling the lull the worst ever, as rising memory prices have led to higher device prices and consumers are choosing to hang on to their old laptops longer. Dell said that it had authorized $25 billion in share repurchases, and that it had spent $4.9 billion in the third quarter on share repurchases and dividends. Dell shares are up over 135% so far in 2026.

headlines.body: 글자크기 설정 기사의 본문 내용은 이 글자크기로 변경됩니다. 젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)가 경영 일선에 복귀하기 직전 이사회에서 기존에 알려진 두 건 외에 추가 혼외 관계를 고백한 것으로 전해졌다. 23일(현지시각) 월스트리트저널(WSJ)에 따르면 황 CEO는 11월 22일 열린 엔비디아 이사회에서 추가 혼외 관계를 공개하고 자신의 행동을 뉘우치는 태도를 보였다. 앞서 알려진 혼외 관계의 상대는 엔비디아 고객사인 메가스피드의 전 임원 앨리스 황과 엔비디아 내부 임원 1명이다. WSJ은 추가 혼외 관계의 구체적인 내용과 상대는 공개하지 않았다. WSJ은 이사회가 후임자 확보의 어려움과 황 CEO의 반성하는 태도 등을 고려해 복귀를 결정했다고 보도했다. 이사회가 황 CEO의 후임자를 물색했지만 회사를 이끌 역량과 의지를 모두 갖춘 후보를 찾는 데 어려움을 겪었다고 부연했다. 한편 황 CEO는 지난 12일 혼외 관계 논란으로 사임한 뒤 11일 만인 23일 경영 일선에 복귀했다. 변상이 기자 difference@chosunbiz.com 이 기사를 공유합니다 관련기사

README:  # NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-4GB ## Description **NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-4GB** is a small language model (SLM) further post-trained from [Gemma-4-E4B-it](https://huggingface.co/google/gemma-4-E4B-it) by NVIDIA. Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B carries forward Gemma’s strong conversational capabilities and further improves multi-turn tool use, instruction following, and input grounding for fast local voice/device assistants, interactive personas, and embedded/edge interfaces. Designed for low-memory, low-TTFT operation, the model allows agents to respond quickly while preserving headroom for applications or adjacent model pipelines. For speculative decoding, use the companion [DFlash drafter](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-4GB-DFlash).
